name: Electrified Floor
body:
School: evocation [electricity]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Prop: Pole

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Area: 10-ft.-radius burst

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Every creature within the area of effect suffers 1d6 points of electricity damage, plus an additional point for each caster level. Affected creatures are also slowed (as per the slow spell) until the end of your next turn. If you are wielding a pole, the target is additionally afflicted with the dazed condition until the end of your next turn.
